about_short_description.short_description: Medplum is a healthcare platform that develops healthcare compliant applications.

product.name: FHIR Datastore and API
product.description: Stores healthcare data in FHIR format, allowing access through a FHIR API with data partitioning and access policies.

product.name: Integration and Interoperability Engine
product.description: Enables unlimited interfaces and integration capabilities for healthcare systems, optimizing interoperability.

product.name: Medplum App
product.description: An administrative tool for developers to manage data and bots, designed to facilitate healthcare application development.

product.name: Authentication and Authorization
product.description: Supports building applications with various authentication methods including Smart-on-FHIR, Google auth, and SAML.

product.name: React UI Components
product.description: Provides a library of React components for building healthcare applications quickly with a customizable user experience.

product.name: Automation through Bots
product.description: Allows for the creation of automations to scale organizational operations, including message routing and care plan instantiation.
